svg.title: Ventilation and the carbon dioxide buffer system
svg.desc: A reversible relationship links carbon dioxide and water to carbonic acid, hydrogen ions and bicarbonate. Inadequate alveolar ventilation can retain carbon dioxide and lower pH. The complete acid-base state also depends on metabolic and renal processes.

g.text: Removing CO2 is part of acid-base regulation
More CO2 removal can raise pH
Interpret with metabolism, renal handling, perfusion and the actual patient
Original conceptual diagram; EtCO2 alone is not a complete blood-gas diagnosis
